row.notes: (lib) Find-or-insert in a robin-hood hash map keyed by a 64-char inline string (key copied from key_holder+0x18, FNV-1a hash, node 0x78 bytes taken from freelist map+8 or FUN_1435e6fd0/FUN_1435e6fe0, buckets +0x28, meta +0x30, count +0x38, mask +0x40), then pushes value onto the node's int64 vector (+0x60 begin, +0x68 end, +0x70 cap, allocator +0x58) and re-sorts that vector ascending with an inlined introsort (FUN_1435e7900). Used by Career_RndConfig_LoadEngineSupplierDeliverySchedules to build per-name sorted delivery schedule lists, so hooking it shows every (schedule name, value) pair as config loads.
